name: uomd
description: Unaware of My Demise - monorepo (Unity 6 LTS C# client, Cloudflare Worker API, React Control Center)

scripts.test: npm run test --workspaces --if-present && npm run test:tools
scripts.build:content: tsx tools/build_content.ts && tsx tools/make_release.ts --dir content/base --id rel_0001 --generation 1 --channel staging --notes "Base content shipped inside the app: first-install flow (prologue + tutorials T-1..T-3)" --created-at 2026-10-10T00:00:00.000Z --out content/base/release.json && tsx tools/seed_assets.ts
scripts.verify: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run check:content
scripts.build: npm run build -w @uomd/game && npm run build -w @uomd/admin
